_comment: Candidate creature scale-ups, OFF by default (scripts/creatures/creature_species.gd _apply_scale_flags). An enabled flag multiplies each named species' placeholder height and collider radius by its factor (>= 1: grow the smaller side, never shrink). The GPU judges an arm by flipping enabled; landing one is a separate gameplay check (bed fit, ride seats, spawn clearance).

creatures_f36_taller_than_trainer._why: CREATURES-F36 (31 Oct). GPU ROSTER-1 High (31 Oct, coordinator): duskhush 6.77 and brooktail 6.84 stand at or barely above the 1.80 m trainer (bounding heights 2.3 / 2.1 m). Hard rule: creatures taller than the trainer; grow the smaller side. CPU r5 (three judges, confirming, r 0.98): duskhush x1.35 5.81 -> 6.31, brooktail x1.4 5.81 -> 6.56. Bramblebun x1.3 (+0.15) and trailpup x1.3 (+0.10) were within noise (their height already read FIXED) and are left out.

creatures_f36_taller_than_trainer_2._why: CREATURES-F36 height batch 2 (31 Oct). GPU roster 24 Oct R3: pipwing 6.66 (1.9 m bounds) and sparkit 6.28 'below the trainer's height' (1.95 m, mostly ears). CPU r9 (three judges, confirming, r 0.95): pipwing x1.6 5.67 -> 6.78, sparkit x1.6 5.62 -> 6.39. Paddlenewt and riftfrill x1.4 (+0.25 / +0.14) and glimmermoth x1.3 (+0.15) left out: their body line still reads low.
